summary: Dashboard Visual QA — 24 acceptance criteria verified. 23/24 PASS, 1 minor issue: top navigation tabs overflow (require horizontal scroll) at 1024px viewport. All structural, layout, and widget checks pass at 1440px desktop. Webstores ribbon unchanged.

issues: T1 at 1024px: NAV element scrollWidth=1430 > clientWidth=1024. The main navigation tabs (Dashboard, Orders, Billing, Customers, Webstores, Documents, Team, AI Tools, Financials, Productivity, Reports, Community, Settings) do not fit at 1024px. Last tabs ('Productivity', 'Reports', 'Community', 'Settings') are hidden/cut off and require horizontal scrolling. The nav has overflow-x-auto so it scrolls rather than wraps, but the criterion says 'fits on screen without wrapping'. Minor issue — the ribbon (h-14) and main content grid are fine.
T19 minor: Today's Schedule card is 334px tall when empty ('Nothing scheduled today' + Calendar button). Slightly tall for an empty state but functionally correct and compact enough.

action_items: LOW: At 1024px viewport width, the top main navigation tabs overflow (last tabs Productivity/Reports/Community/Settings not visible). Consider adding responsive wrapping or a compact nav mode at 1024px if this viewport is important for users.
